primaryChecks.text: Israel stayed in Shittim; and the people began to play the prostitute with the daughters of Moab;

context.text: for they called the people to the sacrifices of their gods. The people ate and bowed down to their gods.

context.text: They traveled from the mountains of Abarim, and encamped in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
